title: Warm Indian Red Onions Lassi
description: A satvik-friendly, Chettinad-inspired lassi featuring roasted red onions, perfect for a hangover cure or a unique snack. This fatty and bouncy drink is made with broiled red onions and yogurt.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a wok, heat the ghee over medium heat and add the cumin seeds and coriander seeds.
Add the chopped red onions to the wok and cook until they are lightly browned.
Transfer the wok to the broiler and broil the onions for 5 minutes, or until they are caramelized.
Remove the wok from the broiler and let it cool slightly.
In a blender, combine the yogurt, roasted red onions, salt, and water, and blend until smooth.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and serve the lassi warm.
Garnish with additional cilantro, if desired.
